The soldier on the right is holding an assault rifle (resembling an M16/M4 variant) in a firing position, with hands gripping the pistol grip and handguard. The soldier on the left is partially visible, wearing a helmet with foliage camouflage. The image has a grainy, high-contrast aesthetic typical of war photography.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight 'smudging' or lack of crisp definition where the fingers wrap around the pistol grip and handguard. The boundary between skin and weapon is slightly soft, suggesting minor generation blur or fusion, though it could also be attributed to motion blur or low-resolution source material.
The geometry of the rear sight assembly is somewhat indistinct and lacks the sharp mechanical edges expected of machined metal. It appears slightly melted into the upper receiver.

To rigorously check for finger fusion with the trigger guard or handguard, a common AI artifact in human-object interaction scenes.
To verify that the rifle sits correctly in front of the soldier's body and that the background foliage has appropriate depth separation.
To assess if the grain/noise is natural film grain or artificial noise patterns often generated by AI to mask structural flaws.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the soldiers' arms and hands, ensuring no extra limbs or impossible joint angles.
